item.title: Ghost in the Wires: My Adventures as the World's Most Wanted Hacker
item.description: Kevin Mitnick was a Top 10 most wanted criminal by the FBI when he went on the run. His exploits are that of legend, and that is part of the problem. Repeatedly, mythical abilities have been assigned to Mitnick when interacting with law enforcement and the judiciary. While his skills were amongst the best in the world, he could not whistle into a phone to order a missile strike. His story is fraught with these mislabelings, and ultimately should have us all asking questions about law enforcement, legal proceedings, and how we handle high tech crimes.
